summary: Harden release procedures with effect inventories, preflight checks, dry-run, idempotent state, interruption recovery, rollback, and noninteractive failure evidence.
triggers: A release script needs dry-run, idempotency, rollback, or stale-state protection.
A local artifact must be separated from a later publish, tag, or deploy effect.
An interrupted release needs typed reconciliation before retry.
antiTriggers: Publish or deploy without the task's explicit external-effect scope.
Retry after a timeout without reconciling possible partial effects.
Read or print credentials as part of a safety check.

provenance.note: Method source read in full and independently rewritten for portable product use; the historical file remains unchanged.
Effect inventory, dry-run, idempotency, interruption, rollback, and failure semantics informed the rewrite; no source prose was copied.
Ownership and evidence boundaries were consulted; no release or deployment result is asserted.
